# Codex seam-to-fixture matrix (GENERATED — do not edit)

Generated by `bun run --filter @evie-kit/goals build` from `packages/goals/src/seamInventory.ts` and `codexSeamRender.ts` (EVA-212 gate 1, ported by EVA-222). The skill text stays authoritative for the discipline. This table is its countable projection: every picker the goals orchestrator raises, the canonical option set, how each runtime renders it, and the fixtures that prove it. `seamMatrix.test.ts` fails when this file is stale or when a label here no longer appears in its owning `SKILL.md`. Which ROLE raises and decides each `goals` seam is the sibling generated reference `seam-ownership.md` (EVA-218); the two share one seam vocabulary, and the goals rows here carry the ownership matrix's ids.

## The two widgets

- **Claude Code** `AskUserQuestion`: up to 4 options, optional preview, built-in "Other" free text. Over-cap sets shrink by the skill's documented drop order; `neverDrop` options are never dropped; a free slot carries `Go Deeper`.
- **Codex** `request_user_input` (0.153.2, Default mode with `default_mode_request_user_input` enabled — checkpoint 0). Each call carries 1–3 questions, 2–3 options each, no preview, a 12-character header, and a client-appended "None of the above" whose note rides the answer as `user_note: …`. Over-cap sets SPLIT into a primary question (recommended first) plus a secondary one carrying the rest — nothing is dropped, every action stays reachable. The last free slot of the last question carries `Go Deeper`.

## Reading an answer (both runtimes)

- Exactly one substantive label → the action.
- "None of the above" / "Other" with a note → free text, NEVER an action — even when the note spells a label; the skill reads it back and re-presents.
- A question-shaped or confusion-shaped note → a clarification STOP; a label beside it is held tentative.
- Two substantive labels across the split questions → ambiguous, a stop signal.
- A cancel-shaped note → cancel. Nothing answered (Codex auto-submits empty after its countdown) → no action.
- A second consecutive clarification → the turn goes prose-only (grill-me step 3).

## The eight skills

| Skill               | Raises                                                                                                                                                             | Skill-eval suite                   |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| goals               | Every lifecycle seam above; the seam rule itself lives in `SKILL.md` § Lifecycle seams are pickers, and each seam's owning role in `references/seam-ownership.md`. | none yet                           |
| grill-me            | Its own one-question-at-a-time interview (open sets, not in this table — the cap and split rules apply per question) plus the ending picker.                       | `skills/grill-me/evals/evals.json` |
| handoff             | The Step 8 ending picker; a watched or hook-triggered handoff ends with the marker instead (no picker).                                                            | `skills/handoff/evals/evals.json`  |
| adhd                | No picker of its own: it is entered from the grill ending (`Run an ADHD pass`) and reports back into grill-me's next question.                                     | none yet                           |
| research            | The approval gate; quick lookups (entity-profile) ask nothing.                                                                                                     | none yet                           |
| publish             | The delivery-seam ask, skipped when `tools.publish.default` or a `publish_sync` stamp already answered it.                                                         | `skills/publish/evals/evals.json`  |
| writing-style-panel | One accept/reject picker per disputed pair at the merge desk; `scan` as a wave row asks nothing.                                                                   | none yet                           |
| domain-modeling     | No picker of its own: glossary and ADR opportunities surface as grill-me questions.                                                                                | none yet                           |

## The Claude skill-eval gate

- Command: the `skill-creator` skill's eval flow (`.claude/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md` § Running and evaluating test cases): one with-skill and one baseline subagent per case in `<skill>/evals/evals.json`, graded by `agents/grader.md` into `grading.json`; trigger accuracy by `python3 .claude/skills/skill-creator/scripts/run_eval.py`.
- Pass criteria: every assertion of every with-skill run grades `passed: true` with cited `evidence`. A with-skill run never scores below its baseline on the same case, and a description change keeps trigger accuracy on the held-out queries.

## Live transcripts versus illustrative fixtures

- LIVE: `goals/EVA-212-codex-goals-orchestrator/results/checkpoint-0/*/picker-*.txt` and `steps.jsonl` — real Codex 0.153.2 renders and answer sheets, redacted. The answer shape the interpreter reads is theirs.
- ILLUSTRATIVE: the fixtures in `packages/goals/src/codexSeamRender.test.ts` and `seamMatrix.test.ts` — hermetic renders and hand-written answer sheets in that same shape; they prove the rules, not a live session.
